infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow camera access only when you choose to capture a photo or video on a social website.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow microphone access only when you choose to record or call on a social website.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo or video to share on a social website.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save an image when you choose to download it from a social website.
